summary: Three worship sites in one community. Cover-page Mass and Confession times agree across the five bulletins read; Confession times follow the cover (the page 10 Sacraments box disagrees and looks stale; the website supports the cover). Included: Immaculate Conception Wed and Fri Adoration, a first-Friday St. Peter Adoration (R12), three monthly midnight holy hours, an Oct 30 Adoration evening, Nov 2 All Souls Mass and Nov 6 Latin Requiem Mass. Open: whether the Friday 9:00 AM (School) Mass is a public Mass at St. Peter.

slots.rationale: R30: a 9:00 AM Mass tagged (School) is listed in the Friday intentions of every bulletin read (Oct 2, 9 'No School Mass', 16, 23, 30) but never in the cover schedule, whose weekday line is Monday-Saturday 7:45am. The tag marks a place the way (St. Bernard) does, and the school is at 145 N. Sixth St. (page 4), which POLICY leaves out when it is another address; but the First Friday Adoration at the church follows a 9:00am Mass, so it may be held in the church. Leaning leave out: no public church time is printed. History had it as a weekly Friday 9:00 Mass.
